BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Breeta!!
See, I told you it's the hanami place~.\nThe preparations for the feast are complete and\nthe cherry blossoms are in full bloom too...Eh?
It's not like they aren't blooming at all, but\nthey're still far from reaching full bloom...
What's going on here? Some of the flowers have\nbloomed, but some haven't!
(Stop being so arrogant just because your flowers\nhave bloomed!)
(Yeah, it's not fair! Your flowers could only\nbloom because Sir Breeta helped you!)
(Hmph! If you're not happy with it, why don't you\nask Sir Breeta to help you too then?)
(Ugh, how annoying!)
You've been spacing out for a while now, is\nsomething wrong?
The sakura fairies are fighting...?\nI wonder why...\nI wanna ask Sherry and Cersier, but...
Why don't you just ask me instead?
Oh, y-you were the bear warrior who competed with\nus to become the sakura warrior!
Baavgai, my name's Baavgai. Please don't forget\nit!
I've been guarding the garden since I officially\nbecame the sakura warrior. I go around and kick\nout intruders. I'm doing pretty well, you know?
So?\nThat means you know why the sakura fairies are\nfighting?
Yep, I guess so. A suspicious guy has been coming\naround recently and trying to get close to the\nsakura fairies.
His face looks familiar.\nOh, right! It's Breeta!
He brought in some strange ashes he mixed himself.\nSpreading them around the trees will instantly\nmake the cherry blossoms burst into full bloom.
What? They'll burst into full bloom instantly?\nBut is that really true?
Well, I'm not really sure, but what he does isn't\na bad thing, and he's actually making the cherry\nblossoms bloom.
However, I never thought that it would cause a\nfight among the sakura fairies.
Hmm, I wonder what Sherry and Cersier think about\nit. I kinda wanna ask them.
Oh, you're here...\nWelcome, welcome...
Er, uhm, sorry...\nI'll see you later...
Hm? Hey, what have you been doing?\nWhat? Sherry left in a hurry?
Well, I don't know since I can't see her...\nI wonder what's going on. Let's go after her!
W-welcome, Breeta!
Oh, Sherry, you look beautiful too today!
You're such a smooth talker, Breeta! I guess I'm\nstill visible to you as usual!
Ohohoho! I conduct research on tree auras, you\nknow! I can even see the happy faces of the\nfairies clearly!
Yeah, everyone's been waiting for you to come!\nCome this way!
Okay, okay, let's go!
Oops, sorry!
B-Baavgai! Please be careful!
I'm really sorry. You'll help make the cherry\nblossoms bloom too today, right? Thanks!
Hmph...
Alright, alright, let's do it Sherry!
O-okay...
Was that Breeta? I know Baavgai was wrong for\nbumping into him, but still, I think he was kinda\nrude.
What? Sherry was there too? That means she was in\na hurry to meet that Breeta guy?
But why? What's so great about him...
You're right...
Long time no see! Thanks for coming again this\nyear, but I'm sorry because the Sakura Garden\nisn't in a good condition for hanami right now.
That Breeta guy first came at the beginning of\nthis year. Sherry and I were very happy because he\nmade the flowers bloom with those strange ashes.
However, he's very moody and he'll only scatter\nthe ashes on the trees of the fairies that he\nlikes.
The fairies who want to make their cherry blossoms\nburst into full bloom with the ashes started\ntrying so hard to make him happy.
And then the fairies who got the ashes and those\nwho didn't began to argue fiercely.
Because of that, they forgot about hanami and only\ncare about making the flowers on their own trees\nbloom.
Come to think of it, no one actually knows what\nexactly those ashes are.
As I realize that it could be dangerous, I told\nSherry to stop inviting Breeta...
But she won't listen to me as she's also looking\nforward to seeing her own cherry blossoms in full\nbloom and the fairies want to see them too.
Hey, who have you been talking to?
What? Cersier is here?\nWhat did she say?
Cersier seems to think that Breeta guy is sus.
I see~. Now I understand why Sherry is so excited\nto see him.
May I please ask you to find out who actually that\nBreeta guy is and the composition of those ashes?
You've volunteered to solve their problem again,\nhaven't you? Tch, you always do that, I'm sick of\nit.
Cersier, I know you're listening, don't worry!\nWe'll definitely solve this problem!
Thank you! Sherry and the future of the Sakura\nGarden depends on you!
Hey, let's go! First we need to see how Breeta\nmakes the flowers burst into full bloom!
Welcome, Sir Breeta!
Thank you for coming, sir!
Please make my cherry blossoms burst into full\nbloom today!
Hmm, well...
Ohohoho! I've decided to help this cutie today!
Oh my goshhh!! Thank you, Sir Breeta!
What?
That's unfair. Sir Breeta just made yours burst\ninto full bloom the other day!
Sorry, but because of some idiot, I only have a\nlittle bit of ash today. There's a limit to the\nnumber of trees I can pamper today.
What?! That's all?!
Sorry, I'll come again soon.
O-okay...I will wait...\nUhm, allow me to walk you to the garden gate.
Wow! He could really make the flowers burst into\nfull bloom!
The flowers smell so good. Now I kinda understand\nwhy the fairies are acting like this.
Hahaha, exactly! Cherry blossoms are best when\nthey are in full bloom!
Oh? It's Virgo! Are you here for hanami?
Yeah! Tenert and Libera went home first, but\nI couldn't give up! I really wanted to feel the\nhanami vibe, even if it's just a little!
It was worth it! Geez, that Breeta guy is quite\nsomething!
Aah! The cherry blossom petals have fallen!!
Oh no, I didn't expect them to fall so fast...
Hahaha, serves you right!
It seems that you got your just deserts for being\ntoo cocky.
Huh! I can just ask Sir Breeta to make my flowers\nbloom again!
What are you talking about? Next is my turn!
No, it's my turn, you know!
Did you see that?! The flowers just fell suddenly.
I had done some research too because we used\nParasiverto before! It's not normal for cherry\nblossoms to bloom and fall so suddenly!
It's because of Breeta's mysterious power, isn't\nit?
Yeah, maybe...I think we need to check the ashes\nthat he makes.
But how can we do that?
Oh? Wait a sec, I think we can get those ashes if\nwe go there, right?
I see. Breeta spilled some of them when I bumped\ninto him...Maybe we can still find some on the\nground?
Good job for remembering that!
I'm serious too this time because it smells like\ntreasure!
Huh? What are you talking about?
Oh, no, forget what I just said.
Alright! I guess this is enough!\nI'll try to analyze it, please wait!
Welcome back! So? Did you find out anything?
Yeah...That Breeta guy is a fraud.
What do you mean?
The crystals scattered by the monsters before are\nfound in the ashes...They'd been finely crushed\nand mixed in the ashes!
What? The monsters' crystals?!
That means Breeta is actually a...
Those crystals won't disappear even if they're\ncrushed into small pieces if the purity is\nincreased. And they can be absorbed more easily
when they're smaller. They'll permeate deep into\nthe trunk before hardening and crystallizing!
That's a big problem!
Hm? By the way, why do the flowers bloom when\nthose crystal fragments are mixed in?
Of course because it's a powerful chemical. Just\nlike how it can steal the vitality from the cherry\nblossom trees, it can also provide it.
It's like the trees are borrowing some vitality in\nadvance. Once the effect of the chemical wears\noff, the damage will be tremendous too.
That's why the flowers also fall so easily. The\nfairies will then become more dependent on Breeta\nand worsen the gap between them.
This is bad...\nSo what are you gonna do?
Explaining it will only backfire.
I'll expose who he really is.
I know right...No matter how we explain it to the\nfairies, they won't listen to us as the they're\nrelying completely on Breeta now.
Yeah, Breeta is like their god now~. First, we\nneed to make them see with their own eyes that\nBreeta is a fraud...!
That will make them understand faster~.
Showing them directly that he's a fraud is\nprobably more effective than trying to convince\nthem with words!
I agree.
Actually, now I know more about the effect of\nchemicals on the trees here after analyzing\nBreeta's ashes and refining Parasiverto last time.
So there's something that I wanna try.
What is it?
Let's prepare some special ashes too and compete\nwith Breeta in a "Flower Blooming Challenge".\nThe fairies will come to their senses if we win.
I see, that's a good idea!
I'll do and prepare what I can now to make the\nashes. You guys please go gather some materials\nfrom the mountains for me!
Well, alright! Let's go to the mountains!
Hmm...Okay, you've got everything I need.
We went through quite a lot of trouble to get\nthem, so don't let our efforts go in vain~!
Ok! Leave it to me!\nAlright, lemme go make it, gimme a minute!
Done! This is the best thing that I've ever made!
It's a chemical made by boiling down all natural\ningredients to maximize the power of the trees\nto make their flowers bloom!
Maybe Breeta's ashes can make the flowers bloom\nfaster, but I'm sure this chemical has no side\neffects that could damage the trees!
That's amazing!\nYou're smarter than I thought!
Nah, to be honest, I just swapped out the crystal\nelement in Breeta's ashes...
It seems that Sherry has showed up.
That means Breeta is here?
Finally, it's showtime!
B-Breeta! Welcome, welcome!
Ohohoho! I brought a lot of ashes with me today.
R-really?! Thank you!
Ohohoho! Don't worry...I just think that this is\nthe right time...
Eh? Did you say something?
No, nothing, forget it...Well, shall we go to see\nall the cuties now?
Hey, wait!
Are you up for a challenge?
W-what?! Guys, please stop, Baavgai, you too,\nplease don't be rude to Breeta!
Huh? What challenge?
A "Flower Blooming Challenge"! Let's see whether\nit's your ashes or the adventurer's ashes that can\nmake the cherry blossoms burst into full bloom!
We already know that you're a bad guy who tricks\nthe tree fairies!
We'll show them that you're a fraud to bring them\nto their senses!
Okay, what if I win the challenge?
We'll leave this Sakura Garden and we'll never\ncome back!
Well, what if I lose?
Same thing! You should leave and never show up\nhere!
Hmm, interesting...Ohohoho, I happened to think\nthat it's boring too to only make the flowers\nbloom.
(They seem to have found out who I really am...\nBut, I've successfully made those cuties like me,\nthere's no room in their hearts for you guys.)
So? What do you say?
Ohohoho! Fine!\n"Flower Blooming Challenge" accepted!
Sir Breeta! I've been waiting for you!
Sir Breeta! Please, make my flowers bloom today!
No way! Please scatter those ashes for my cherry\nblossoms!
Ohohoho! I'm sorry my cutie pies, but first I'd\nlike you to join a little game with me.
Okay...
What little game?
I need to compete against this kiddo next to me\nto see who can make the cherry blossoms bloom more\nbeautifully.
So I need you cutie pies for this challenge.
You mean you'll make our cherry blossoms bloom?
Ohohoho! Yeah of course, that's the plan.
Okay, okay! I volunteer!
M-me too! I'll help too!
Me too of course!
You guys really know what's good for yourselves.\nOkay, please line up for this kiddo. I'll be in\ncharge of the cuties over there.
What? Oh no...
I thought you were gonna do it for me, sir.\nI'm disappointed.
I can't believe that a stranger will be in charge\nof my tree. I shouldn't have agreed to do this.
(They are so mean...)
(Women can be merciless at times like this, you\nknow...)
Hey, please say something you guys. By the way,\ncan you hear the fairies, Virgo?
I can understand even though I can't hear them...
Only men can understand this...
(To me it sounds like what unattractive men would\nnormally say. Lemme just ignore it.)
C'mon, show him what you got!!
We're rooting for you! Don't lose to him!!
Ohohoho! Alright, the "Flower Blooming Challenge"\nbegins now!!
Listen to Pelulu's instructions and scatter\nthe ashes nicely on the cherry blossoms!
A strong wind is blowing from the right~!
A nice and gentle breeze is coming from the left~!
Hmm, there's no wind at all~!
Right side of the tree (*scatter)!
Left side of the tree (*scatter)!
The roots of the tree (*scatter)!
Nice! Thanks to the wind, the ashes are spread\nevenly!
What are you doing?! The ashes got blown away by\nthe strong wind!
Well, if you scatter the ashes around the roots,\nthe wind won't be a problem~.
The ashes are spread quite evenly because the wind\nis weak~!
The ashes are spread nicely all over the trunk~!
Oh my gosh! The ashes failed to go with the wind.\nThey just clumped and fell onto the ground!
Because there is no wind, the ashes are covering\nyou instead of the trees!
It seems that the ashes bounce off the trunk and\nget scattered quite nicely~!
The ashes are being absorbed slowly from the\nroots. It's looking good~.
Hmm, you're doing better than I expected.\nOhohoho! Honestly, I'm quite impressed.\nHow-e-ver...
It seems that you still have a long way to go\nbefore you can match my flower blooming technique.
Oh! Sir Breeta, you're amazing as always!
I knew it, I actually wanted you to be in charge\nof my tree too, Sir Breeta!
It looks like this stranger is not good enough...
Ohohoho! Anyone can tell who the winner is, right?\nIt's obvious. Now, as promised, you'll get out of\nhere, right...?!
Wait!
Celesa and Caylass?!\nWhat brings them here...
It seems that the winner is the adventurer.
W-whaat?!
Simply being in full bloom is not enough. Cherry\nblossoms are admired for their color, individual\nbeauty and harmony with the surrounding scenery...
Besides, I can feel the vibrancy from the cherry\nblossoms of the adventurer, but Breeta, right? Not\nfrom yours. It's like they've already fallen...?
Ahaha, they've already fallen. That automatically\nmeans we have the result now.
T-that's not because of my ashes...
Stop playing dumb, Breeta!\nWe already know that you're up to no good!
Crystals have appeared on the trunks of the cherry\nblossom trees that have been exposed to your\nashes. They're clearly losing their energy.
We've already treated them. It could have been\nserious if left untreated.
We've got a report from Cersier and heard about\nthe adventurers' plan too. We actually wanted to\nwait until the fairies realize it themselves...
Breeta, you mixed those crystals in your ashes,\ndidn't you?
No way...Breeta...
Ugh! How annoying! I was so close to getting a\nton of crystals!
You left me with no choice. I'll just cut down\nevery single tree and turn this place into a\ngarden with dead trees!
Nice, I prefer seeing you in this form! It makes\nit easier for me to punch you!
Let's not forget our true purpose...
Y-yeah, I know, you don't need to remind me.
You've finally revealed your true form~!!
This is getting troublesome!! Let's split up to\nprotect the trees!!
Okay!! Hey, we'll leave that Breeta guy to you!!
Hey, that's not fair! Don't forget to let me beat\nhim a few times too later!
I made the fairies fight so that I can slowly turn\nthem into my slaves...
Everything was going so well until you showed up!\nYou've ruined my plan! I'll make you pay with your\nlife!
